name: Hammat
title: Founder of the House of Rekab
summary: Hammat is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the father of the house of Rekab. He is associated with the Kenites and the city of Hammat. He appears in the genealogies of Chronicles, and his descendants, the Rechabites, later became known for their faithfulness to the commands of their ancestors.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hammat is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the father of the house of Rekab, in connection with the genealogies of Judah's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Kenites
keyEvents.description: Hammat is linked to the Kenites who came from Hammat, the father of the house of Rekab. The Kenites were a people closely associated with Israel.

keyEvents.title: Faithfulness of the Rechabites
keyEvents.description: Hammat's descendants, the Rechabites, became known for their faithfulness to the command of Jonadab son of Rekab not to drink wine and to live in tents, which was praised by the prophet Jeremiah.

keyEvents.title: God's Blessing on the Rechabites
keyEvents.description: Because of the Rechabites' obedience to their ancestors' commands, God promised through Jeremiah that there would always be a man from the house of Rekab standing before the Lord.
